title: Arcade Token Change Counter
description:
## Task

An arcade change machine pays out tokens worth 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50 and 100 credits. Given an amount of credits, return the fewest tokens that add up to exactly that amount. Always hand out the largest token that still fits.

## Input

- `amount` — the credits to pay out, a non-negative integer.

## Output

The smallest number of tokens (an integer). An amount of 0 needs 0 tokens.

## Example

```python
arcade_tokens(289)  # returns 8
arcade_tokens(0)  # returns 0
arcade_tokens(8)  # returns 3
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ `amount` ≤ 10^9
- Token values are fixed: 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100.
